//: AFC-331 (docs/protocols/per-call-identity.md section 5):  the notes_* tools, one contract for the stdio server and the hosted Worker.  The hosted src/notes.js and stdio tools.py both serve these specs unchanged;  a test checks the two sides.

tools.name: notes_create
tools.title: Notes Create
tools.description: Create an Apple Note in the owner's Coding folder, pinned by default.  On a Mac it is written directly (status done);  anywhere else a request is posted to #notes-relay and the Mac listener writes it (status queued, then notes_status).  The title must read "[APP, Agent] topic" and Agent must be the identity you act as, or the relay refuses it.  A session id is required (see the session argument) unless the identity is a single-thread one.

title.description: The note title, "[APP, Agent] short topic" such as "[AFC, Claude] relay rollout".  Agent is the name of the identity the call acts as.  It must start with [ and hold no double quote or backslash.

markdown.description: The note body as Markdown (or HTML when html is true).  Two spaces between sentences.

html.description: The body is HTML, not Markdown.

pin.description: Pin the note to the top of the Coding folder (the default).

notify.description: Also push a notification to the owner.

needs_owner.description: Mark the note as needing the owner's review or action (also notifies).

summary.description: A one-line summary for the notification and the note's quick view.  No double quote or backslash.

pr.description: Pull request numbers for the note's date line, such as "46" or "46, 47".

request_id.description: A unique id for this request, 8 to 64 letters, digits, - or _.  A retry with the same id never writes the note twice.  Omit it and the server makes one.

session.description: The session id of the agent session writing this note, stamped in the note as its Session line so a headless resume can find the session.  Required for every identity except the single-thread ones (Grok bots, Rob, Jet, Wise, Echo), which may omit it.  Omit it when the server's environment already has it (AGENT_SESSION, or the platform variable such as CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID or CODEX_THREAD_ID);  a hosted server has no environment, so pass it.  4 to 128 letters, digits, . _ : or -.

transport.description: auto writes the note directly on a Mac and posts a relay request everywhere else;  relay always posts the request to #notes-relay.

tools.name: notes_status
tools.title: Notes Status
tools.description: Where a relayed notes request stands, from the Mac listener's reaction on the request in #notes-relay:  queued (no answer yet), done (checkmark) or refused (cross mark, with the listener's reason).  Give the request_id a notes tool returned.  Read-only.

request_id.description: The request_id a notes tool returned.

message_id.description: The message_id it returned, when you have it (skips the search).
